name: Not reachable
description: Agents cannot reach or read the store: robots.txt blocks the crawlers behind AI answers, the scanner's honest request is challenged, or product pages need JavaScript to show their content.

name: Reachable
description: robots.txt can be read, the crawlers behind AI answers may read product pages, an agent that names itself honestly is not challenged, and product content is in the HTML.

name: Readable catalog
description: Level 1, and an agent can list the catalog (a product sitemap, a platform API, a public feed or Shopify's agent catalog). Product pages may appear in AI answers and carry Product structured data with a complete offer.

name: Identifiable products
description: Level 2, and products carry a valid GTIN or a brand with the maker's part number, and name the brand as an entity.

name: Trusted merchant
description: Level 3, and an agent can find the return, shipping, privacy and terms pages and a way to contact the merchant.

name: Checkout-ready
description: Level 4, and the store advertises a checkout an agent can use: a UCP profile with a checkout capability and a payment handler, an ACP discovery document, or an active Shopify agentic storefront. This means the public prerequisites are in place. It does not mean a purchase was tested.
